_about: Phone camera per dunk clip at frame 0, in court_render.py coordinates (metres, y up, rim centre at (-1.600, 3.048, 0), board face toward -x, +z = right when facing the board from the court). pos is RIM-RELATIVE (the clip's hoop lands on the renderer's hoop even when the real rim is lowered; true heights in rim_height_true_m / camera_height_true_m). yaw/pitch/f as court_render.Camera: yaw 0 looks along -z, + turns toward +x; pitch + = down; use Camera(720, 1280) with CAM_F = CAM_F_2560 (= f_px * 2560/720) and cy_frac = image.cy_frac. roll = rotation about the view axis, + = camera's right side up (court_render ignores it; apply it to compositing). image: exact pinhole model (720x1280, principal point, f in px, no distortion). rim_err_px / hoop_err_px / floor_err_px: RMS reprojection error of the marks on the marked frame. track: per-frame yaw/pitch/roll/f/cy (rotation-only, position fixed) for every frame of the clip. Made by Tools/Brand/clip_cameras.py from clip_cameras_marks.json.

image.model: pinhole, square pixels, no distortion; x right, y down; frame 0 of the clip

OneHandOffVert.notes: Backyard in-ground hoop, 72 in acrylic board. Rim is LOWERED: ~2.90 m (9.5 ft) from the player-height cue (pole base + player feet/head); renderer pos keeps the camera where it is relative to the rim (true camera height in camera_height_true_m). Handheld: drifts ~14 px at the rim by the last frame (see track).
